isEasyExchange.description: Flag to indicate if this is an Easy Exchange (random partner).

message.description: Optional message attached to the exchange offer or completion.

partner.description: The DID of the exchange partner.

refPartner.description: URI of the partner's profile, used for Constellation backlinking during the offer stage.

refTransaction.description: URI of the referencing transaction (e.g., the original Offer) when completing or rejecting.

status.description: The current status of the transaction.

stickerIn.description: URIs of the stickers received in this exchange (if completed).

stickerOut.description: URIs of the stickers given in this exchange.
